subject: Tenant commencement: API keys & invite plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@greenlinehealth.com>, Tom Hayes <thayes@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant commencement: API keys & invite plan

Hi Sara / Tom —

Great to kick this off. To keep the initial tenant activation tight, here are the items we typically do in the first 72 hours and what we need from your side: 

1) Project & namespace: we create a customer project (namespace)——please confirm preferred short name (suggest: greenline-prod).
2) API keys/service accounts: we seed one admin API key and one service account key for server-to-server ingestion. Tell us the expected service account name you want in logs (e.g., greenline-ingest).
3) Admin invites: list of 2-3 platform admins to invite (email + full name).
4) Roles mapping: a quick mapping you approve (Admin, Dev, Read-only).
5) SSO / domain allowlist: confirm SAML provider or domain to allow.
6) Timeline & go/no-go date: propose your ideal activation window.

I've attached a short onboarding summary with the standard role templates. If you'd like, Jasmine will run an invite sprint and seed the keys while Karthik schedules the Dedicated capacity handoff.

Proposed timeline: 
- Day 0: project and admin invites sent
- Day 1: API keys seeded and test tokens verified
- Day 2: SSO + role validations and smoke tests

Please confirm the three items we need (project short name, service account name, and admin invite list) and we will queue the work.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
redwood_inference.com
Attachment: redwood_onboarding-summary.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
From: Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@greenlinehealth.com>

Monica —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick answers from our side: 

- Project short name: greenline-prod (confirmed)
- Service account name for logs: gln-ingest-service
- Admin invite list: 
  - Sara Wilson <sara.wilson@greenlinehealth.com> (Platform lead)
  - Tom Hayes <thayes@greenlinehealth.com> (SRE)
  - Priya Desai <priya.desai@greenlinehealth.com> (Security)

We use Okta SAML for SSO; I’ll share the metadata file once we’re in the docs. Target go-live: prefer Wed 17 Sep (gives us time for an internal security sign-off).

On your seeding: can the service account key be rotated via KMS in our AWS account? If not, note any constraints.

Appreciate it — Sara

Sara / Team —

Thanks for the quick replies — below is the execution runbook I will run as the invite/key owner. I will send invites and seed keys once you confirm the Okta metadata and whether you want KMS-hosted keys in your AWS account.

Execution runbook (Jasmine):
- Step 1 (T+0): Create project namespace: greenline-prod; add initial billing tag GF-4721.
- Step 2 (T+0.5): Seed admin API key (expires 1 year) and create service account gln-ingest-service (key material: JSON).
- Step 3 (T+1): Send admin invites to Sara, Tom, Priya with Admin role. Invite email contains 2FA and SSO instructions.
- Step 4 (T+1.5): Run basic smoke test: call /v1/engines/status and /v1/keys/validate (expect 200/ok).
- Step 5 (T+2): If Okta metadata present, configure SAML SSO and confirm SSO login for 2 admins.
- Step 6 (T+2-3): Role mapping validation with Security (Priya) and SRE (Tom).

KMS note: We can either store the key material in Redwood-managed KMS or generate the key locally and wrap it with your AWS KMS if you provide an IAM role. If you want the latter, Karthik can take the KMS handoff and provide the role to assume. Please confirm preferred option.

Attached: MAP_Tenant_Seed.xlsx (action tracker) — I’ll update row statuses live as we progress.

Links: Onboarding drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cOnboardingDrive), HubSpot record HS-381729.

If Wed 17 Sep works for you, I’ll schedule the invite sprint for Tue 16 Sep to seed keys and run smoke tests on Wed morning.

—Jasmine
Customer Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_Tenant_Seed.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Looping in ops for the KMS handoff. Internal notes: 

- If Greenline wants AW KMS wrapping, we will need an IAM role with sts:AssumeRole and a small policy that allows kms:Encrypt/decrypt on the specific key ARN. Request SRE (Tom) to provide the role ARN by EOD Tue 16 Sep.
- I will pre-create the namespace greenline-prod in our staging cluster and put a placeholder tag GF-4721:preseed. Keys will be in disabled state until confirmation.
- I’ll run the migration checklist and share the post-activation checklist with CS so they can confirm smoke tests.

Next steps: 
- Sara/Tom: send Okta metadata + desired KMS approach.
- Monica/Jasmine: schedule invite sprint (Tue 16 Sep) if Wed 17 Sep remains the target.

Thanks,
Karthik
